description: On exit signal ('wrap up the day'), attempted to execute shutdown cleanup myself (git operations, file cleanup) instead of spawning Rigby to execute the shutdown-cleanup workflow. SYSTEM.md CLAUDE.md states 'Wrap up the day and clean up' should delegate to Rigby via workflows/shutdown-cleanup/workflow.md. Routing table also shows infrastructure/deployment tasks route to Rigby.
correction: When exit is signaled, Master must spawn Rigby with workflows/shutdown-cleanup/workflow.md as the payload. Do NOT attempt git commits, file cleanup, or artifact organization directly. Rigby owns the full shutdown-cleanup workflow end-to-end.
systemic_fix: Add hard-stop rule to CLAUDE.md exit behavior: 'EOD wrap-up ALWAYS delegates to Rigby via shutdown-cleanup workflow. Master never commits files or cleans artifacts directly.' This needs to be above the working-memory-sweep step in the exit sequence.
